prompt:
Night, open farmland in 1924: a black steam locomotive halted on the line, its headlamp blazing sideways through great rolling clouds of white steam that fill the frame. Seen from low in the trackside ditch with a 35mm lens looking up at the roof of a dark-red wooden mail car. On the roof BOTTLE (bottle-green balaclava, oatmeal ring, brown tweed suit) heaves a plain canvas mail sack down to a black 1932 Ford sedan with its doors open, where RUST (rust-gold balaclava, black ring, black double-breasted suit) catches it. Beside Bottle, PLUM (plum balaclava, cream ring, mustard chalk-stripe suit) and SILVER (silver-grey balaclava, crimson ring, oxblood suit) face the lens, gloved fists punching the air. Each mask is hand-knitted rib wool, smooth knit where the face would be, with a rounded red felt triangle over the right eye, on the left of the picture. Car headlights glow amber through the steam.

Thanks.
